## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with big single-stock rallies (CSCO, PANW, AMD) but broad sector dispersion. Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 span 3 sectors), confirming a neutral, stock-specific market.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leading: XOM (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +2.53%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples steady: PM (1W: +12.13% | 1M: +22.06%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +12.97% | 1M: +14.53%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -12.91%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Communication down: CHTR (1W: -7.64% | 1M: -32.82%) BELOW TREND, broader communication names under pressure. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND, other travel-related names lagging.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +20.38% | 1M: +15.36%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +12.97% | 1M: +14.53%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +12.13% | 1M: +22.06%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -23.54%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -15.47%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology and select Utilities.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Largest 1W movers: CSCO (1W: +25.36%), PANW (1W: +21.21%), F (1W: +20.38%), MNST (1W: +12.97%), PM (1W: +12.13%) — all ABOVE TREND. Watch FCX (1W: +9.12% | 1M: -3.73%) RECOVERY and META (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -7.91%) RECOVERY as short-term divergences rather than confirmed regime shifts.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is bifurcated: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND versus CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -3.13%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +2.04% (24 stocks) — momentum in names, but breadth uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are soft overall: JPM (1W: -2.08% | 1M: -1.97%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -5.77%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: -0.91% (20 stocks) — dispersion across banks and payments keeps Financials neutral-to-weak.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed with select strength: UNH (1W: +7.94% | 1M: +27.08%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -16.96%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.73% | 1M: -3.30%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: +1.01% (17 stocks) — defensive hedges present but uneven.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Stay selective: favor leading individual names (CSCO, PANW, NVDA, UNH, AMD) while reducing exposure to structurally weak, high-multiple laggards (CRM, SHOP, BKNG). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — manage position sizes and watch for confirmation before scaling.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +25.36% | 1M: +40.27%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +21.21% | 1M: +45.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -16.96%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (select leaders) and Energy on relative strength (Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive). BEARISH: Communication and Utilities remain at risk while Financials need clearer follow-through.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +11.46% | 1M: +18.54%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuation above recent 1M highs to confirm breakout. AAPL (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +12.03%) ABOVE TREND — hold of 1W support would keep momentum intact. CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim the 1W range risks further distribution. FCX (1W: +9.12% | 1M: -3.73%) RECOVERY — watch 1M resistance for reversal confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMD (+55): Price confirming — AMD (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +74.22%) ABOVE TREND after price-target upgrades and strong Q1 commentary. AMAT (+65): headline bullish on AI infra (sentiment positive); monitor for price follow-through (selective names in Tech confirming).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CRM (-50): Enterprise software downgrade; CRM (1W: -10.07% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price weakness. BKNG (-55): guidance cut & debt news; BKNG (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. FCX (-50): operational headwinds; FCX (1W: +9.12% | 1M: -3.73%) RECOVERY — sentiment diverging from 1W bounce, monitor commodity flow. BA (-45): political/contract risk; BA (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +2.36%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL market regime with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value leadership) and Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. CSCO, PANW, NVDA, UNH, AMD showing relative strength (all ABOVE TREND). Key risk: concentrated leadership and headline-driven weakness in CRM/BKNG while AMD/selected tech sentiment is confirming price — monitor for broader follow-through.
